summary.quick_take: Carrd and Squarespace both sit in the broader website builder landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Carrd leans into recurring lifetime payouts, while Squarespace leans into one-time payouts. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
